more.def: To choose one thing or person from a group.

examples: We picked strawberries at the farm on Saturday.

easy.def: To see something in your mind.

more.def: To form an image of something in your mind.
examples: Close your eyes and picture a quiet forest.

more.def: A single work of music, writing or art.
